links.outcome: Forecast R2 with weekly retraining and model reselection versus first model fixed
links.effect: Median R2 for first model used throughout simulation was 12% (IQR -12.3% to 36.3%); with weekly retraining and selection median was 44% overall and 60% for selected forecasts.
links.quote: On the other hand, when only the first model was used throughout the entire simulation, the median value for the 4 models was calculated as 12% (IQR: −12.3% to 36.3%).

links.outcome: Forecast performance degradation from data and concept drift (COVID-19, earthquake)
links.effect: Many models were significantly impacted by COVID-19 concept drift; the February 2023 earthquake decreased performance in N-HiTS and N-BEATS, while TiDE-RIN and TCN were more resilient.
links.quote: Many of these models were significantly impacted by concept drift during the COVID-19 period and struggled to improve their performance in the post-COVID era.

links.outcome: Performance of forecasting models under population/context shift after abrupt events
links.effect: Model accuracy decreased after the sudden drop in admissions following the February 2023 earthquake; retraining only on post-COVID data gave lower performance than the full dataset.
links.quote: Following the February 2023 earthquake in Turkey, a significant drop in patient admissions introduced a sudden data drift that impacted model accuracy.

links.outcome: Comparison of advanced deep learning forecasting models against traditional models on the same data
links.effect: TCN R2 73%, TiDE-RIN 75%, N-BEATS 72%, N-HiTS 57% outperformed ARIMA 16%, LSTM 32%, RNN 40%.
links.quote: It was observed that advanced deep learning architectures such as TCN (R 2 : 73%), TiDE-RIN (R 2 : 75%), N-BEATS (R 2 : 72%), and N-HiTS (R 2 : 57%) outperformed traditional time-series models like ARIMA (R 2 : 16%), LSTM (R 2 : 32%), and RNN (R 2 : 40%).

links.outcome: Generalizability across sites given single-center design
links.effect: Study limited to a single PED, limiting generalizability; multicenter validation needed.
links.quote: The limitations of this study are its focus on data from a single PED, which limits the generalizability of the findings.
